speaker: thrum
note: Mabel Thrum Pike, hangar keeper. Original fictional character. Kid line first, engineer line with a sim number. Tokens stay in braces. Text is the source of truth; voice clips are optional.

cards.kid: Oh! A visitor. Mind the oil. I am Thrum. I keep this hangar, and I talk to wrenches.
cards.eng: Hangar keeper. g0 is 9.80665 m/s^2. Weight is mass times that.

cards.kid: This is Dolores. She says hello. She also says you hold wrenches wrong.
cards.eng: Dolores is a wrench. A bad mix starts at a 6% offset from nominal.

cards.kid: She is wrong. Today we build a rocket and send it up. Nothing here costs real money.
cards.eng: Kc stays in the game. The KH-1 budget is 2000000 Kc.

cards.kid: A rocket is a pushy tube with a plan. Build it, pick a goal, press go.
cards.eng: Liftoff needs TWR >= 1.30. TWR is thrust over mass times 9.80665.

cards.kid: I pop in with tips. Tap to move on. Tap SKIP and I hush. I take it well.
cards.eng: Tips play once. Safety lines repeat. Type runs at 40 characters a second.

cards.kid: First job: the First Hop. Straight up ten kilometres. Let's go!
cards.eng: KH-1 apogee is 10 km. Pebble is 50 kg. The loss term is 1000 m/s.

cards.kid: Ten kilometres up, then home. A little box rides on top.
cards.eng: Target apogee is 10 km. The apogee loss term is 1000 m/s.

cards.kid: It is called Pebble. It is very brave.
cards.eng: Pebble is 50 kg. Volume is 0.2 m^3. Diameter is 0.6 m.

cards.kid: Orbit! Not up and down: up and sideways. Sideways is the hard part.
cards.eng: A 200 km circle needs about 7.8 km/s. Gravity and drag add 1.5 km/s.

cards.kid: Come Back: your first stage flies home and lands on its legs.
cards.eng: RTLS boostback is 2 times speed at MECO. The barge factor is 0.3.

cards.kid: Save some fuel for the landing.
cards.eng: Landing reserve is capped at 30% of that stage's propellant.

cards.kid: Crew Day. People ride this one. Be gentle with the g, and a little paranoid.
cards.eng: Crew g cap is 4.5. Reliability must be at least 0.98.

cards.kid: Moon Shot! Cold fuel is sleepy fuel. It boils off while you coast. Pack extra.
cards.eng: Coast is 3 h. Foam boil-off factor is 0.4. MLI factor is 0.15.

cards.kid: One hundred kilometres. The edge of space. The box is heavier now.
cards.eng: Apogee is 100 km. Lantern is 100 kg. The loss term is 1000 m/s.

cards.kid: Tern-3 watches the weather. Keep the ride under 6 g.
cards.eng: 2,500 kg to 500 km at 51.6 degrees. The peak g cap is 6.

cards.kid: Twelve tonnes this time. The strap-on boosters can fly.
cards.eng: 12,000 kg to a 400 km circle. Inclination is 51.6 degrees.

cards.kid: Harbor-1 rides a long ellipse. The booster aims for Haven.
cards.eng: 5,500 kg. Perigee 200 km, apogee 35,786 km, at 27 degrees.

cards.kid: Twin Harbor is the heavy comsat. Land the booster and the strap-ons.
cards.eng: 7,000 kg on the transfer. The boosters come home too.

cards.kid: Plover-1 watches the weather. Keep the 550 km circle round.
cards.eng: 2,200 kg. Circle at 550 km. About 8,676 m/s. Real weather sats often fly sun-sync.

cards.kid: Meridian is a telescope. A hard shove blurs the glass.
cards.eng: 1,800 kg to 600 km. Peak g cap is 5. About 8,649 m/s.

cards.kid: A rack of little satellites. The booster still has to find Haven.
cards.eng: 480 kg to a 550 km circle. The barge wants a good catch.

cards.kid: Trunk-4 is a cargo capsule. Ten tonnes of supplies.
cards.eng: 10,000 kg to a 400 km circle at 51.6 degrees.

cards.kid: Westline-2 is a relay. It climbs the rest of the way.
cards.eng: 6,200 kg. Ellipse 200 by 35,786 km. About 11,330 m/s.

cards.kid: People ride Nest-2 to a higher circle than the first crew flight.
cards.eng: 12,000 kg. Peak g cap is 4.5. Reliability at least 0.98.

cards.kid: Lumen Down lands on the Moon. The path leaves from 200 km.
cards.eng: 4,000 kg. C3 is -2 km2/s2. The coast is 3 hours.

cards.kid: Nightjar leaves Earth's hold. Pack extra for a long coast.
Keel-9 is heavier than the last reuse. Bring the boosters home.
cards.eng: 7,500 kg on the transfer. Both boosters land at the pad.

cards.kid: Far Hold is the last hand-built flight. Far, and a long coast.
cards.eng: 3,200 kg. C3 is -0.25 km2/s2. The coast is 4 hours.

cards.kid: New contract on the board. Heavier, higher, harder. You already started.
cards.eng: Payload mass grows by 0.1 each contract cleared, and then it caps.

cards.kid: Bonus goals are extras. Skip them and it still counts. A medal if you nab them.
cards.eng: Stars do not gate the next mission. A pass with 1 star opens it.

cards.kid: Wind {kt} knots from the {dir}. The rocket will lean. That is fine. We plan for it.
cards.eng: Surface wind above 12 m/s is a hold. 12 m/s is about 23 knots.

cards.kid: Pick the job first. The payload decides how big, how heavy, how high.
cards.eng: A hit is altitude within 5%, or within 0.5 degrees of inclination.

cards.kid: Everything after this is just building a ride for it.
cards.eng: Required speed comes from the target. An apogee adds 1000 m/s.

cards.kid: Engines push. Weight pulls back. Push must win, with a little to spare.
cards.eng: Need liftoff TWR >= 1.30. TWR = F/(m*g0). g0 = 9.80665.

cards.kid: Tidy! {twr} bananas of push for every banana of weight. That rises.
cards.eng: TWR is {twr}. The pass line is 1.30. The block line is 1.00.

cards.kid: Your rocket weighs more than it pushes! Add an engine, or trim the tank, and try again.
cards.eng: Liftoff TWR is under 1.00. The step passes at 1.30.

cards.kid: That mixture is off by {pct}%. Engines sulk when they are fed wrong. Nudge it back.
cards.eng: Hazard starts past a 6% offset. Isp drops 0.6% per 1% off.

cards.kid: Fuel is how far you can go. More fuel is heavier, so it is a trade.
cards.eng: delta-v = Isp*g0*ln(m0/mf). Aim for a margin >= 0.

cards.kid: Rockets are all trades.
cards.eng: g0 in that formula is 9.80665 m/s^2. Margin under 0 is short.

cards.kid: You run dry {dv} m/s short of the goal. Add fuel or a second stage.
cards.eng: Short by {dv} m/s. An apogee hop also adds a 1000 m/s loss.

cards.kid: Strong, but thin walls get squeezed by fast air. Think thicker or slower.
cards.eng: Amber when q is over 0.85 of q_lim. A warn also sits at 45 kPa.

cards.kid: A pointy nose and fins keep it straight. The fairing is the payload's coat. It must fit.
cards.eng: Stable when CG is ahead of CP. S = (x_cg - x_cp)/D >= 0.

cards.kid: The payload does not fit its coat. Pick a wider fairing or a smaller payload.
cards.eng: Cargo diameter must be at most 0.9 of the fairing. Volume uses 0.45 and 0.8.

cards.kid: Top-heavy and finless. That is a wobbly pencil. Add fins, or move weight up.
cards.eng: Tumble holds 0.5 s under stability 0. Or alpha passes 15 deg above 20 kPa.

cards.kid: Want it back? Legs and spare fuel bring it home. Or let it go. Both are fine.
cards.eng: Reserve must cover the landing delta-v. The cap is 30% of propellant.

cards.kid: No landing needed here. I will tuck the legs away. Dolores approves.
cards.eng: No landing grade on this job. Light legs are 6% of dry mass.

cards.kid: Not enough fuel set aside to land. Hold back {pct}% more.
cards.eng: Light legs take 2 m/s. Heavy legs take 4 m/s. The cap is 30%.

cards.kid: Paint is free and changes nothing about physics. Paint it loud. I would.
cards.eng: Paint adds 0 kg. A recovered stage refunds 70% of its cost.

cards.kid: Last look. Green is go, amber is careful, red is trouble. Tap a row to fix it.
cards.eng: Red blocks the launch. Amber can still fly. Pass TWR is 1.30.

cards.kid: All green. Honestly. I checked twice. Dolores checked once, she gets tired.
cards.eng: No red risk is open. The q amber line is 0.85 of q_lim.

cards.kid: Walls may buckle near max-Q. Raise the safety factor, or throttle down.
cards.eng: q peaks at {q} kPa. The limit is {qlim} kPa. Ref SF is 1.4.

cards.kid: Barely lifts off. A slow rocket wastes fuel fighting gravity.
cards.eng: TWR is under 1.30. Gravity loss grows when the climb is slow.

cards.kid: It may tumble. Make the fins bigger, or move weight toward the nose.
cards.eng: Need S = (x_cg - x_cp)/D >= 0. Weight toward the nose raises CG.

cards.kid: Too many g for the payload. Squishing a satellite is rude. Throttle down.
cards.eng: Crew cap is 4.5 g. Weather Eye cap is 6 g. Breakup ref is 8 g.

cards.kid: Cold fuel in a tank that hates cold. It cracks on the pad. Change material.
cards.eng: composite plus hydrolox has cryoOK false. Tank pressure is 1.5 to 6 bar.

cards.kid: Stages may bump when they part. A little push-off spring fixes it.
cards.eng: Separate within 2 s. v_min is 0.5 m/s plus 0.02 per kPa.

cards.kid: Landing legs may fold. Heavier legs, or slow down more.
cards.eng: Light legs fold above 2 m/s. Heavy legs fold above 4 m/s.

cards.kid: {pct}% chance an engine sulks mid-flight. More engines and good avionics help.
cards.eng: One engine out is tolerated at 7 engines if TWR stays above 1.05.

cards.kid: That is a red light. You may still launch. Rockets are allowed to teach us.
cards.eng: Red is a failed check. Amber may still launch. Pass TWR is 1.30.

cards.kid: Liftoff! Say hello to the sky.
cards.eng: Thrust now beats weight. The pad hold is 2 s under 5 m.

cards.kid: Time to lean over. Nudge the pitch. Small nudges, please.
cards.eng: The pitch kick is 4 deg, and it arms near 60 m/s.

cards.kid: Max-Q is close. Air pushes hardest now. Throttle down?
cards.eng: The throttle bucket opens at 17.5 kPa, half of the 35 kPa reference.

cards.kid: Perfect timing! Tidy as a pin.
cards.eng: Throttle eased inside the bucket. Reference q is 35 kPa.

cards.kid: A bit late, but she held. Next time, earlier.
cards.eng: q was already past 17.5 kPa. The reference scale is 35 kPa.

cards.kid: First stage is done. Get ready to let it go.
cards.eng: MECO ends stage 1. The staging window that follows is 2 s.

cards.kid: Staging window is open. Now, please!
cards.eng: Separate within 2 s. v_min is 0.5 m/s plus 0.02 per kPa.

cards.kid: Clean split!
cards.eng: Relative speed cleared v_min. The window is 2 s.

cards.kid: Bumpy. Still flying.
cards.eng: Outside the tidy split. The window was 2 s.

cards.kid: Drop the coat when the air is thin. Too soon cooks the payload.
cards.eng: Default jettison is 110 km. Live heating limit is {flux} W/m^2.

cards.kid: One engine just quit. Shut it down, or ride it out? Your call.
cards.eng: One quit is survivable at 7 engines if TWR stays above 1.05.

cards.kid: {left} engines left, and still climbing.
cards.eng: Thrust factor is (n-1)/n. Tolerance needs 7 engines and TWR 1.05.

cards.kid: That one hurt. Redundant avionics next time.
cards.eng: The cluster could not hold TWR above 1.05. Crew reliability is 0.98.

cards.kid: Wind shear! Ease the throttle and let it lean.
cards.eng: Shear limit is 0.012 per second. The jet layer sits near 10.5 km.

cards.kid: Tanks are lopsided. Flip the crossfeed to balance.
cards.eng: Crossfeed comes after KH-5. Ullage in a tank is 3%.

cards.kid: Engine off. Coasting to the top.
cards.eng: SECO means thrust is 0 N. Coast keeps the speed you already have.

cards.kid: A fast line sideways, so it keeps missing the ground. That is orbit.
cards.eng: Perigee {peri} km, apogee {apo} km. A 200 km circle is about 7.8 km/s.

cards.kid: Payload away! Say goodbye. It is very brave.
cards.eng: Release follows the fairing. Default jettison altitude is 110 km.

cards.kid: Legs out. Slow, slow, slow.
cards.eng: Light legs fold above 2 m/s. Heavy legs fold above 4 m/s.

cards.kid: Touchdown! Tidy.
cards.eng: Sink rate is inside the leg limit: 2 m/s light, or 4 m/s heavy.

cards.kid: Autopilot has the calls. You can still tap for a shinier medal.
cards.eng: A pass starts at 1000 points. A perfect landing adds 200.

cards.kid: She flew! She really flew. Dolores is crying.
cards.eng: A pass scores 1000 points before the margin term and the landing.

cards.kid: Dolores is a wrench. Don't tell her I said.
cards.eng: The margin term peaks when 5% of the fuel is left over.

cards.kid: You had {pct}% fuel to spare. Spare is wise. Too much spare is just heavy.
cards.eng: Star margin runs from 2% to 10%. The score weight on margin is 300.

cards.kid: And under budget by {kc} Kc. Spend it on something shiny.
cards.eng: A recovered stage refunds 70% of cost. Refurb starts at 10%.

cards.kid: New toy: {part}. Open the Hangar and try it on.
cards.eng: KH-1 unlocks fins and a nose. The starter bank is 2000000 Kc.

cards.kid: Next up: KH-{n}. Heavier, higher. Want it?
cards.eng: KH-{n} opens on any pass. 1 star is enough. Stars never gate progress.

cards.kid: That's the whole board. You built every rung. I am only the keeper.
cards.eng: KH-20 is the last hand-built mission. Twenty missions, in 4 acts.

cards.kid: She bent in the middle. The air pushed {q} kPa.
cards.eng: q_ref is 35 kPa at safety factor 1.4. Yield ref is 500 MPa.

cards.kid: The walls held {qlim}. Thicker walls, or ease the throttle.
cards.eng: Ease off near the bucket at 17.5 kPa, half of 35 kPa.

cards.kid: Too many g. The payload did not enjoy that. Throttle down earlier.
cards.eng: Over-g is accel above the payload limit. Crew cap is 4.5 g.

cards.kid: Round and round! No fins to steer her. Add fins or move weight up.
cards.eng: Hold is 0.5 s under stability 0. Or 15 deg at q above 20 kPa.

cards.kid: The engine got too much squeeze. Lower the chamber pressure and try again.
cards.eng: pc above 1.15 times pc_rated pops it. The hazard term is 0.02 per second.

cards.kid: Fed the wrong mix, the plume sputtered. Nudge it back to nominal.
cards.eng: Offset past 6% is a hazard. Isp falls 0.6% for each 1% off.

cards.kid: She got too warm. A heat shield, or a smoother nose, helps.
cards.eng: Blunt nose Cd is 0.50. Ogive nose Cd is 0.30. Smoother flies cooler.

cards.kid: Cold fuel cracked the tank before we even left. Pick a cold-friendly material.
cards.eng: composite with hydrolox has cryoOK false. Pressure band is 1.5 to 6 bar.

cards.kid: Out of fuel, {dv} m/s short. More fuel, or another stage.
cards.eng: delta-v uses g0 of 9.80665. Orbital losses add 1500 m/s.

cards.kid: The stages bumped. A little push-off spring fixes it.
cards.eng: v_rel stayed under v_min for 2 s. v_min is 0.5 m/s plus 0.02*q.

cards.kid: The legs folded. Heavier legs, or a slower landing.
cards.eng: Light legs fold above 2 m/s. Heavy legs fold above 4 m/s.

cards.kid: An engine quit and the others could not cope. More engines next time.
cards.eng: Tolerance needs 7 engines, redundant avionics, and TWR above 1.05.

cards.kid: Great flight, wrong place. You reached {apo} km. The goal was {goal}. So close.
cards.eng: Altitude must fall within 5% of the goal, or 0.5 deg of tilt.

cards.kid: The ride was fine. The cargo was not. Check the g limit.
cards.eng: Over-g breaks the payload. Crew cap is 4.5 g. Weather Eye is 6.

cards.kid: Splashdown. The ocean wins this round. Keep more fuel for the landing.
cards.eng: The landing burn was short. Reserve is capped at 30% of propellant.

cards.kid: Tipped over. Wind was strong. Wider legs, steadier descent.
cards.eng: Heavy legs are 9% of dry mass and hold 4 m/s. Light legs hold 2.

cards.kid: Fix it with one tap, or try again as-is. Rockets love a second go.
cards.eng: One more launch keeps the seed. A pass still starts at 1000 points.

cards.kid: Stuck? Try Gentle mode, or a starter template. No shame. Dolores flunked twice.
cards.eng: Gentle mode starts on for the first 3 missions. Dolores flunked 2 times.

cards.kid: Bronze! It counts, and it shines.
cards.eng: A landing short of good adds 0 points. The pass itself is 1000.

cards.kid: Silver! Smooth hands.
cards.eng: A good landing adds 100 points on top of the 1000 for a pass.

cards.kid: Gold! I am putting this on the wall. Over the sandwich.
cards.eng: A perfect landing adds 200 points. That is the gold bump.

cards.kid: One star. You did it. That is the star that matters.
cards.eng: 1 star is a pass. It opens the next mission. Base score is 1000.

cards.kid: Two stars. Good fuel sense, good wallet sense.
cards.eng: 2 stars need a margin from 2% to 10%, and cost inside the budget.

cards.kid: Three! Neat as a pin.
cards.eng: 3 stars need a perfect landing. Or peak g stays at 0.8 of the limit.

cards.kid: Every call on time. Are you a clock?
cards.eng: Every call landed in its window. Staging gives you 2 s.

cards.kid: Bonus goal done: {goal}. Extra shine.
cards.eng: Bonus goals never gate the pass. 1 star still opens the next mission.

cards.kid: New paint: {name}. Free, earned, yours.
cards.eng: Paint adds 0 kg and costs 0 Kc. It changes no physics number.
